cohort: 648 pregnant women >20 years old, with a gestation of >22 weeks, admitted for delivery at two hospitals in Colombo, Sri Lanka, with 326 in the AMA group and 322 in the 20-34 years age group.
finding: Compared to women aged 20-34 years, advanced maternal age (AMA) was associated with higher income, postponement of current pregnancy, subfertility, caesarean delivery, and pre-term delivery.
